note: Small-body shape model sources. fetch-shapes.mjs downloads 'url' to data-raw/smallbodies/<id>/<file>; build-shapes.py converts them to public/data/smallbodies/shapes/<id>.bin. 'format' selects the reader; 'targetTris' is the QEM decimation target (null = keep the source mesh).
